data.name: Juwain
data.gender_notes: Juwain is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'Jawwana', meaning pure or clean. Also conveys the idea of physical beauty and handsomeness. The name Juwain carries the meaning “Pure, Handsome” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Juwain usually hope their child will grow to embody pure, handsome and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Juwain is a spiritual name that reflects the inherent worth and value of every human being. It reminds us that each person is a precious gem, unique and irreplaceable, and that we should strive to cultivate our inner wisdom and intelligence in order to fulfill our highest potential.
data.etymology: Juwain belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Pure, Handsome.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Juwain total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
